newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn approves Zambia air accord.
newsitem.headline: Bonn approves Zambia air accord.

text.p: The German government has approved a bill to bring an air accord between Germany and Zambia into national law, the transport ministry said.
German transport minister Matthias Wissmann said in a press statement the agreement was a further step in the expansion of air traffic relations between Germany and Africa.
The rights under the agreement, signed in March 1994, are not used by any airline at present, it added.
Airlines from Germany and Zambia are allowed to fly up to twice-weekly to one destination in the other country under the accord. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
